name: Wanted: DWARVES!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
By order of Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl, all dwarves on the field of battle are to be killed on sight.

Should you slay a dwarf in combat, rip out their spine, leaving a spineless heap of stink and rot to serve as a warning to any and all that dare oppose the might of the Frostwolf.

Return to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl with proof of your heroics.
narrative.objectives:
You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in Alterac Valley.

Kill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at Frostwolf Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You now have license to decimate dwarves by the dozen, Champion!

<Yazra stares off into the distance for a moment.>

You never forget your first de-spining...
narrative.requestItemsText: I deal in wholesale irony, soldier.

objectiveItems.name: Dwarf Spine
sources: Snowblind Harpy in Alterac Valley and 4 more
